title: Long birch ply desk
summary: A long birch ply desk with a shelf underneath, running along the wall of a garden room.
intro: A long work surface for a garden room in Chiswick: a birch ply desk with a shelf underneath, on steel legs. The boards were cut to size in the room, so the desk fits the wall it runs along.
